518 :                             results[mount]['info'].update(mount_size)
519 :                         results[mount]['info']['uuid'] = uuid or 'N/A'
520 :                     else:
521 :                         # give incomplete data
522 :                         errmsg = to_text(res.get())
523 :                         self.module.warn("Error prevented getting extra info for mount %s: %s." % (mount, errmsg))
524 :                         results[mount]['info']['note'] = 'Could not get extra information: %s.' % (errmsg)
525 : 
526 :                     mounts.append(results[mount]['info'])
527 :                     del results[mount]
528 :                     break
529 :                 elif time.time() > results[mount]['timelimit']:
530 :                     results[mount]['info']['note'] = 'Timed out while attempting to get extra information.'
531 :                     mounts.append(results[mount]['info'])
532 :                     del results[mount]
533 :                     break
534 :             else:
535 :                 # avoid cpu churn
536 :                 time.sleep(0.1)
537 : 
538 :         return {'mounts': mounts}
```"
